blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Metadata-conditioned generation is often framed as a data-to-text task in which additional input fields should improve grounding. Museum description generation challenges this assumption because catalogue records are heterogeneous, partially visual, and unevenly documented across geographic regions. We study how metadata composition shapes the generation of artefact descriptions through a two-phase framework. Phase 1 analyses natural metadata variation in a large museum collection, where field count, field type, image availability, and Place co-vary. Phase 2 introduces controlled field probes that hold object identity fixed while varying metadata quantity, field type, and image access. Our results show that metadata quantity alone does not explain generation behaviour. Field type determines whether models ground, omit, or infer information, while images can both support visual grounding and increase unsupported interpretation. More broadly, our findings show that metadata-conditioned data-to-text evaluation should assess field- and claim-level support, rather than relying only on aggregate input coverage or reference similarity.
blocks.zh: 以元数据为条件的生成常常被设定为数据到文本的任务,在这种任务中,额外的输入字段应改善基础。 博物馆描述生成质疑这一假设,因为目录记录多种多样,部分可视化,而且各地区的记录不均匀。 我们研究元数据组成如何通过两个阶段的框架来形成人工描述的生成。 第1阶段分析大型博物馆藏品中的自然元数据变异,其中的场数,场型,图像可用性,以及Place Co-vary. 第2阶段引入了具有固定对象身份和不同元数据数量、字段类型和图像访问的可控域探测器。 我们的结果显示,仅元数据数量并不能解释生成行为。 字段类型决定模型是地面,省略,还是推断信息,而图像既可以支持视觉地面,又可以增加不支持的解释. 更广泛地说,我们的调查结果表明,以元数据为条件的数据对文本的评价应评估实地和索赔一级的支助,而不应仅仅依赖总输入覆盖面或参考相似性。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large language models (LLMs) are invreasingly used in cultural heritage settings to generate public-facing object descriptions from structured catalogue records Bu et al. (2025) ; Trichopoulos (2023) . This is a metadata-conditioned data-to-text task: it requires fluent prose that stays faithful to a bounded, heterogeneous set of catalogue fields.
Data-to-text benchmarks such as E2E, WebNLG, RotoWire, and ToTTo have driven progress on content selection, fluency, and faithfulness ( Novikova et al., 2017 ; Gardent et al., 2017 ; Wiseman et al., 2017 ; Parikh et al., 2020 ) , with evaluation focused on reference similarity, input coverage, and
hallucination ( Dušek and Kasner, 2020 ; Pagnoni et al., 2021 ) . However, this framing leaves unexplored how the composition of the input itself shapes generation.

E2E、WebNLG、RotoWire和Totto等数据到文本基准推动了内容选择、流利和忠诚方面的进展(Novikova等,2017年;Gardent等,2017年;Wiseman等,2017年;Parikh等,2020年)。

blocks.en:
Cultural heritage collections make this question especially important. Museum records are structured, but they are not uniform: catalogue fields differ in their epistemic status. Artefacts may encode provenance facts, physical descriptors, production dates, curatorial classifications, subject annotations, inscriptional content, and named associations within a single attribute set.
These fields differ in the extent to which a model can be expected to recover missing values from domain priors.
Multimodal models exacerbate this effect: an image supports description of form, colour, appearance, and visible markings Liu et al. (2023) , but cannot ground production place, excavation context, date, or associated historical figure. A model that conflates these grounding sources generates fluent prose that is, on the surface, indistinguishable from faithful description Maynez et al. (2020) ; Ji et al. (2023) . Field coverage is, in addition, systematically non-uniform across collections and cultural-geographic regions, reflecting heterogeneous acquisition histories and cataloguing conventions Srinivasan (2017) ; van Hooland and Verborgh (2015) .
As a result, metadata is not only an input representation for generation, but also a trace of prior documentation practice.
blocks.zh:
文化遗产的收藏使这个问题特别重要。 博物馆记录结构化,但内容不统一:目录领域在认知状态上有所不同. 艺术品可以将出处事实,实物描述,制作日期,典籍分类,题词说明,铭文内容等编码,并在单一属性集内命名协会.
这些字段的不同之处在于,一个模型可以在多大程度上从域前缀中恢复缺失值。
多式联运模型加剧了这种效果:图像支持对形式、颜色、外观和可见标记的描述 刘等 (2023年),但不能进行地面出产地,出土背景,日期等相关历史人物. 一种将这些地基来源混为一谈的模式会产生流利的道教,从表面上看,这种道教与忠实的描述Maynez等人(2020年)是分不开的;Ji等人(2023年). 此外,实地覆盖面在收藏品和文化地理区域之间有条不紊,反映了不同的获取历史和编目公约(斯里尼瓦桑(2017年);van Hooland和Verborgh(2015年)。
因此,元数据不仅是生成的输入表示,也是以往文献实践的痕迹.

blocks.en: Prior work does not isolate these dimensions. Cultural-heritage evaluation often aggregates quality across examples or fields, and reports regional gaps observationally Ghaboura et al. (2025) , making it difficult to determine whether errors arise from metadata quantity, field identity, image availability, or domain-specific priors. Additionally, cultural heritage research has largely focused on improving access to collections, producing engaging descriptions, or linking heterogeneous museum records ( Hyvönen, 2012 ; Candela et al., 2023 ) , but less often examines how different metadata configurations change what models include, omit, or infer.
blocks.zh: 以前的工作并不孤立这些层面。 文化继承评价常常将质量汇总到各种实例或领域,并报告从Ghaboura等人(2025年)观察区域差距,因此难以确定元数据数量、实地身份、图像可用性或特定领域前科是否产生错误。 此外,文化遗产研究主要侧重于改善对藏品的取用、制作接触性说明或将各种博物馆记录联系起来(Hyvönen,2012年;Candela等,2023年),但较少审查不同的元数据配置如何改变模型包括、省略或推断。

blocks.en: This paper asks: how do metadata quantity, field type, image availability, and place-specific documentation patterns affect what LLMs include, omit, and infer in museum description generation? We address this question with a two-phase study on the TimeTravel benchmark ( Ghaboura et al., 2025 ) . Phase 1 provides a corpus-scale observational analysis over 10,250 10{,}250 historical and cultural artefacts generated under each record’s full available metadata. It shows that reference-based quality varies with metadata composition, but that naturalistic records confound field count, output length, and field composition: output length increases with field count ( η 2 = 0.33 \eta^{2}=0.33 ), while longer generations receive lower BERTScore across civilisations ( r = − 0.34 r=-0.34 to − 0.70 -0.70 ). Phase 2 introduces a controlled field-type probing framework that independently varies field count, field type, and image availability within the same objects across ten experimental conditions. Two matched-count arm sequences extend from a common sparse baseline: the context arm ( S_ctx ) adds fields encoding the geographic, historical, and associative circumstances of the object ( Find spot , Place , Assoc name ), and the content arm ( S_cont ) adds fields encoding properties directly perceivable from or readable on the object ( Subjects , Technique , Inscription ). We evaluate each generation using reference-based surface similarity, NLI-estimated field coverage, and claim-level factuality via nugget extraction and verification.
blocks.zh: 本文询问:元数据数量、字段类型、图像可用性和特定地点的文献模式如何影响LLMs包括、省略和推断博物馆描述生成中的哪些内容? 我们对时间旅行基准(Ghaboura等,2025年)进行了分两阶段的研究,以解决这一问题。 第一阶段提供10 250 10{}250多件历史和文物的观测规模分析,这些文物是根据每个记录的全部现有元数据产生的。 它表明基于参考的质量因元数据组成而异,但自然学记录混淆了字段计数、输出长度和字段构成:输出长度随字段计数而增加(η2 = 0.33\eta^{2}=0.33),而较长的世代则在文明间获得较低的BERTScore(r = 0.34 r=-0.34至 0.70-0.70). 第2阶段引入了控制字段型检测框架,在10个实验条件下在同一个物体内独立地改变字段计数、字段类型和图像可用性. 两个相匹配的臂序从一个共同的稀有基线延伸:上下文臂(S_ctx)添加了对对象的地理,历史和关联环境的编码(Find spot, Place, Asoc name),而内容臂(S_cont)则添加了直接从对象中可被感知或可被读取的属性(Objects, Technique, Inscription). 我们利用基于参考的地表相似性、NLI估计的实地覆盖面和通过提取和核查的声称层面的事实来评估每一代人。

blocks.en: Our results show that more metadata does not simply make generations more grounded. Increasing field count improves coverage of provided fields but can also increase unsupported inference over withheld fields. Field identity determines the dominant failure mode: contextual fields tend toward omission, while content fields are incorporated more readily but at higher hallucination risk. Images provide visual grounding in sparse settings but also encourage inference beyond the catalogue record. Place-level patterns further show that metadata effects depend on documentation practices and cultural-geographic priors, making field-level evaluation necessary for understanding LLM-generated museum descriptions.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果表明,更多的元数据并不能简单地使世代更加扎根。 增加实地统计可以改善所提供字段的覆盖范围,但也能够增加对被扣字段的无支持推论。 外地身份决定了主要的失败模式:上下文字段倾向于省略,而内容字段则更容易被收录,但有较高的幻觉风险。 图像在稀少的环境下提供可视定位,但也鼓励在目录记录之外进行推论. 地平面图案还进一步表明元数据效应取决于文献惯例和文化地平面前科,使得实地评价对于理解LLM生成的博物馆描述是必要的.

blocks.en: We make three contributions. (1) We introduce a controlled field-type probing framework isolating the effects of metadata quantity, field type, and image access on LLM-generated museum descriptions. (2) We show that more metadata does not improve faithfulness monotonically: increasing field count improves coverage of provided fields but increases unsupported inference over withheld fields, with contextual and content fields failing through distinct mechanisms. (3) We show that place-level variation reflects field–region interactions and documentation practices, motivating field- and claim-level evaluation for metadata-conditioned generation.
blocks.zh: 我们作出了三项贡献。 (1)我们采用一个可控的场型探测框架,隔离元数据数量、场型和图像访问对LLM生成的博物馆描述的影响。 (2) 我们显示,更多的元数据并不能单调地提高忠诚度:增加实地统计可以改善所提供字段的覆盖范围,但增加了对被扣字段的无支持推论,而背景和内容字段通过不同的机制失效。 (3) 我们显示,地点一级的变化反映了实地-区域互动和文献做法,促使实地和索偿一级对元数据的生成进行评价。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Data-to-text generation Our work is situated in data-to-text generation, where
benchmarks such as E2E and WebNLG study generation from meaning representations and RDF triples, emphasising content selection, lexicalisation, aggregation, and surface realisation Novikova et al. (2017) ; Gardent et al. (2017) . Longer-form data-to-document tasks such as RotoWire show that generation from structured records also requires maintaining fidelity to the input database Wiseman et al. (2017) , while controlled table-to-text settings such as ToTTo restrict the input evidence through selected table cells to support more controlled evaluation of grounded generation Parikh et al. (2020) . Museum description generation is a metadata-conditioned form of data-to-text generation, but with heterogeneous and incomplete records whose fields differ in availability and interpretive status.
blocks.zh:
数据到文本生成 我们的工作是数据到文本的生成,其中
基准,如E2E和WebNLG研究生成,取自意为表示和RDF三重体,强调内容选择、词汇化、聚合和地表实现Novikova等人(2017年);Gardet等人(2017年)。 RotoWire等更长形式的数据到文档任务显示,从结构化记录生成也需要保持对输入数据库Wiseman等人(2017年)的忠诚性,而TOTTo等受控的表格到文本设置则通过所选的表格单元格来限制输入证据,以支持更可控的对被定位生成者Parikh等人(2020年)的评价. 博物馆描述生成是一种以元数据为条件的数据到文本生成形式,但记录不一和不完整,其领域在可用性和解释性地位上有所不同。

blocks.en:
Faithfulness in grounded generation A central challenge in grounded generation is that fluent outputs may include unsupported content. This problem has been widely studied in summarization, where models may generate hallucinated or factually inconsistent claims despite high surface quality Maynez et al. (2020) ; Pagnoni et al. (2021) . Atomic claim-level verification has been proposed to improve factuality assessment beyond binary judgements Min et al. (2023) .
In data-to-text generation, factual grounding is similarly central: models may omit input facts, hallucinate unsupported content, or generate claims that cannot be traced to the source record Wiseman et al. (2017) ; Wang (2019) . We build on this line of work by analysing faithfulness at the metadata-field level.
blocks.zh:
忠诚于被禁足的一代 扎根一代中的一项中心挑战是,流利的产出可能包括不支持的内容。 这个问题在总结中被广泛研究,模型可能会产生幻觉或事实上不一致的说法,尽管表面质量高的Maynez等 (2020年); Pagnoni等 (2021年). 已提议对原子索赔水平进行核查,以改进除二进制判决之外的事实质量评估。
在从数据到文本的生成中,事实地基也是类似的中心:模型可能省略输入事实,幻觉不支持的内容,或者产生无法被追溯到源记录Wiseman等人(2017年);Wang (2019年). 我们在这项工作的基础上,通过分析元数据领域的忠诚度。

blocks.en:
Generation from cultural heritage data The use of LLMs on and for cultural heritage data is extensive. For example, Bu et al. (2025) study how various open source LLMs answer questions about a museum exhibition; Trichopoulos (2023) finetune an LLM with collection data to serve as a chatbot; Arnold and Tilton (2024) use LLMs to generate captions and explanations for image archives; Reusens et al. (2025) employ LLMs to generate keywords from written descriptions of museum objects. Generating natural language from museum collection databases has been studied in the past as a structured NLG
problem Isard et al. (2018) , demonstrating that metadata records can support adaptive visitor-facing
texts. In line with this, we generate descriptions based on structured records consisting of both images and metadata.
blocks.zh:
文化遗产数据的生成 在文化遗产数据上和用于文化遗产数据的有限责任制度得到了广泛使用。 例如,Bu等人(2025年)研究各种开源LLMs如何回答关于博物馆展览的问题;Trichopoulos(2023年)用收集数据来微调LLM,作为聊天机;Arnold和Tilton(2024年)使用LLMs来生成图像档案的字幕和解释;Reusens等人(2025年)使用LLMs从博物馆物品的书面描述中生成关键词. 过去曾研究过从博物馆收藏数据库中生成自然语言作为结构化的NLG
Isard等人(2018年)的问题,表明元数据记录可以支持适应性访问者——显示
发文。 据此,我们根据由图像和元数据组成的结构化记录生成描述。

blocks.en:
Metadata completeness is a central dimension of metadata quality ( Bruce and Hillmann, 2004 ; Matoni et al., 2026 ) . However, cultural heritage records are often incomplete. In Cultura Italia, for example, even mandatory fields are frequently missing ( Lorenzini et al., 2021 ) . These gaps are not random. Metadata creation and aggregation reflect judgements about what information is valuable, which makes documentation practices subjective and culturally situated ( Lewis et al., 2025 ) . As a result, completeness can vary systematically across subcollections, communities, or domains. This phenomenon is captured by Metadata Completeness Disparity ( Battaner and Spence, 2026 ) .
To account for this, our work studies cultural heritage artefacts from various regions. By investigating how metadata completeness, image availability, and region interact and shape generation, we provide insights into whether models respect the boundary between verified catalogue information and model-supplied contextualisation.
blocks.zh:
元数据完整性是元数据质量的一个核心方面(Bruce and Hillmann,2004;Matoni等人,2026)。 然而,文化遗产记录往往不完整. 例如,在Cultura Italia,甚至连必修栏也经常缺失(Lorenzini等,2021年)。 这些差距不是随机的。 元数据创建和汇总反映了对哪些信息是有价值的判断,这使得文件编制做法具有主观性和文化位置(Lewis等人,2025年)。 因此,完整性在不同子集、社区或领域之间可能存在系统性差异。 元数据完整性差异(Battaner and Spence, 2026)抓住了这一现象。
为此,我们的工作是研究各区域的文化遗产。 通过调查元数据完整性、图像可用性以及区域互动和形状生成方式,我们深入了解模型是否尊重经核实的目录信息和模型提供背景的界限。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en:
To understand how museum description generation is affected by the count and type of fields and whether visual support is available, we propose a
two-phase controlled field-type probing framework: Phase 1 measures generation under natural metadata variation, while Phase 2 applies controlled field probes that hold object identity fixed and vary metadata composition and image access.

二相受控场型探测框架: 第1阶段在自然元数据变异下测量生成,而第2阶段则采用控制外野探测器,这些探测器持有对象身份固定并改变元数据组成和图像访问.

blocks.en: 3.2 Two-Phase Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 3.2 两相实验设计

blocks.en: Phase 1: natural metadata variation. Phase 1 evaluates generation under the metadata naturally available for each object. We prompt each model with the object’s populated catalogue fields and image, generating descriptions for 10,250 10{,}250 objects with four LLMs. This phase captures realistic collection-level variation, where field count, field type, image availability, and place co-vary and cannot be independently attributed to observed differences in generated descriptions, thus our motivating phase 2.
blocks.zh: 阶段1:自然元数据变异. 第一阶段根据每个对象自然可以得到的元数据评价生成情况。 我们用对象的集合目录字段和图像来提示每个模型,生成10,250 10{}250个带有四个LLM的物体的描述. 这个阶段捕捉到现实的收集级别变异,即场数,场型,图像可用性,并放置同声器,不能独立归结于所观察到的生成描述的差异,因此我们激励的第二阶段.

blocks.en: Phase 2: controlled field probes. We construct Phase 2 as a within-object design over 500 500 objects balanced across values of the Place field. Objects are sampled from place-relative high-completeness tiers, rather than a global completeness threshold, to avoid making metadata quantity a proxy for civilisation (Appendix A.1 ; Table 6 ). Each object appears under multiple prompt conditions (Table 2 ), so comparisons are paired within object. Object identity, and prompt template remain fixed, while field composition and image access vary.

blocks.en:
Controlled generation conditions. We define ten generation conditions (Table 2 ) that vary field count, field type, and image availability.
Condition S is a three-field baseline comprising Materials , Culture , and Production date , selected because each is populated for nearly all of the benchmark objects. Six of the ten conditions form a 2 (field type) × \times 3 (field count) design over this baseline: each arm extends S by one field per level, so that level k k is a superset of level k − 1 k-1 .
The two arms partition the added fields along the content–context distinction ( Gilliland, 2016 ) : content comprises properties intrinsic to the object, including its subject matter, means of production, and any text it bears; context comprises properties extrinsic to the object, recording the circumstances of its creation, provenance, and custodial history.

内容包含物体内在属性, 包括其主题、生产资料和它所携带的任何文字; 上下文包含物体外在属性,

blocks.en:
The context arm ( S_ctx 4–6) adds Find spot , then Place , then Assoc name , which link the object to external documentary and associative records.
The content arm ( S_cont 4–6) adds Subjects , then Technique , then Inscription , which encode properties observable in the object or inscribed on it, although assigning catalogue values to them requires expert interpretation.
Field order within each arm is fixed across all objects and models, so level k k denotes an identical field set for every generation.
The arms are matched on field count at levels 4, 5, and 6, and object identity, prompt template, and image availability are held fixed across matched pairs, so differences at a given level are attributable to field type rather than field count.
The remaining four conditions: R and T bound the field range, and S_noi and R_noi withhold the image.

每个臂内的字段顺序固定在所有对象和模型上,因此k级表示每个代都有一个相同的字段设置.

blocks.en: Claim-level factuality. NLI provides one entailment verdict per field and cannot identify which claims in the generation are responsible for that verdict. We therefore apply a two-stage nugget pipeline to verify factual accuracy at the claim level. Stage 1 decomposes g g into atomic claims, attributing each to a field f ∈ F all f\in F_{\text{all}} or classifying it as extra content when no schema field accounts for the claim.

blocks.en: Stage 2 verifies each attributed claim against F all F_{\text{all}} , assigning supported , hallucinated , or not_verifiable with error-type classification ( Table 9 ). Both labels are defined relative to the catalogue record rather than to external fact: a claim is hallucinated when the field to which it is attributed has a recorded value and the claim is not supported by that value, and not_verifiable when the field has no recorded value against which to assess it. A claim may therefore be historically accurate or visually correct and still be labelled hallucinated . Pipeline validation is reported in Appendix A.4 .

blocks.en:
Human calibration. We assess the reliability of the claim-level pipeline against human annotation.
Two annotators independently labeled a stratified random sample of 350 claims, drawn proportionally across conditions, following an annotation protocol derived from the Stage 2 prompt.
Inter-annotator reliability is substantial (Cohen’s κ = 0.78 \kappa=0.78 ), with category-specific agreement of 96% for supported and 87% for hallucinated , showing that human raters apply the verdict criterion consistently without reference to the pipeline.
Human–pipeline reliability is κ w = 0.67 \kappa_{w}=0.67 with category-specific agreement of 89% for supported and 73% for hallucinated . This shows that our nugget pipeline is able to correctly attribute most nuggets to their specific fields.

blocks.en: 4.1 Phase 1: Surface metrics invert documentation completeness

blocks.en: Phase 1 generates descriptions under each artefact’s full available metadata. Figure 1 (a) shows that mean description length increases monotonically with field count, from 160 to 213 words across the range of 3–9 fields, while mean BERTScore-P decreases from 0.863 to 0.839 over the same range. Across regions, BERTScore is consistently and negatively associated with description length, with correlations ranging from r = − 0.34 r=-0.34 to r = − 0.70 r=-0.70 s ( η 2 = 0.33 \eta^{2}=0.33 for the length–field-count relationship Table 13 ): indicating that more fields correspond to longer generations, which receive lower BERTScore against the per-object reference description.

(2025) . 2 2 2 Per-model results across all surface metrics are reported in Appendix B.1 . For primary fields, coverage remains stable across all field counts, ranging from 0.90 0.90 to 0.93 0.93 , while hallucination rates vary between 0.07 0.07 and 0.10 0.10 . Field type changes the dominant failure mode. The claim-level pipeline reveals systematic differences between matched-count conditions. S_ctx conditions are more conservative and more faithful on primary fields: S_ctx4–6 achieve primary coverage of 0.937 0.937 – 0.949 0.949 with hallucination rates of 0.040 0.040 – 0.044 0.044 (Table 3 ). blocks.en: Table 4 shows that, Subjects and Technique have the highest primary hallucination rates ( 24.2 % 24.2\% and 21.3 % 21.3\% ), far above fields such as Culture ( 1.3 % 1.3\% ) and Production date ( 1.7 % 1.7\% ). blocks.en:
Withheld-field follows the same field-type split. Wrong bonus mentions exceed correct ones overall, indicating that unprompted field recovery is more often speculative than reliable. The highest bonus wrong rates occur for Technique ( 51.7 % 51.7\% ) and Subjects ( 41.8 % 41.8\% ). In the S_ctx arm, where S_cont fields remain withheld, bonus wrong increases from 0.308 0.308 in S_ctx4 to 0.421 0.421 in S_ctx6 , while bonus silence decreases from 0.577 0.577 to 0.360 0.360 (Table 3 ). Additional context from S_ctx increases completion of the withheld record, but much of this completion is unsupported. In contrast, withheld S_ctx and association fields are usually omitted: Find spot has 99.2 % 99.2\% bonus silence and 0.4 % 0.4\% bonus wrong, while Place and Assoc. name show bonus silence rates of 86.8 % 86.8\% and 88.0 % 88.0\% . Field type, therefore, determines whether missing information is omitted or speculatively completed, making field count alone insufficient for explaining claim-level faithfulness.
The gap widens along the S_ctx arm, from 15.5 15.5 pp at count 4 to 34.5 34.5 pp at count 6, while bonus silence diverges in the opposite direction, from 0.577 0.577 against 0.786 0.786 to 0.360 0.360 against 0.864 0.864 (all p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).

Deployment in cultural heritage settings therefore requires region-specific quality assurance rather than a single global accuracy threshold.

The contribution of visual input to primary grounding is therefore conditional on metadata density, and is not detectable once the prompt specifies all available fields.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our results show that metadata-conditioned generation is not only a question of input coverage, but also of field–claim alignment. Adding metadata changes what models mention, but also how they redistribute information across catalogue fields, visual evidence, and domain priors. This challenges the prevailing data-to-text assumption that richer inputs consistently improve generation quality.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果显示,以元数据为条件的生成不仅是一个输入范围的问题,而且也是一个字段-要求一致的问题。 添加元数据会改变模型的提法,但也会改变它们如何在目录领域、视觉证据和域前科之间重新分配信息。 这对普遍的数据对文本的假设提出了挑战,即较丰富的投入不断提高生成质量。

blocks.en: First, metadata quantity is not a reliable indicator of grounding. In Phase 2, increasing field count improves coverage of provided fields but also increases hallucination over withheld fields. Better grounding of visible metadata can therefore coincide with weaker respect for the metadata boundary. Additional fields change the distribution of claims in the output: models mention more catalogue-supported information, but they also produce longer descriptions with more opportunities for unsupported elaboration. This distinction is visible in the metric results. Field-count correlations with BERTScore vary across regions, whereas output length is consistently and negatively associated with BERTScore. Surface metrics, therefore, risk penalizing grounded elaboration while rewarding shorter descriptions that are closer to the reference but less complete.
blocks.zh: 首先,元数据数量并不是一个可靠的基础指标。 在第二阶段,增加实地清点提高了所提供作业的覆盖范围,但也增加了对被扣作业的幻觉。 因此,改善可见元数据的基础,可能与对元数据界限的尊重程度降低相吻合。 额外的字段改变了索赔在产出中的分布:模型提到更多目录支持的信息,但也产生更长的描述,并有更多的机会进行不支持的阐述. 这种区别在衡量结果中显而易见。 实地统计与BERTScore的相关性因区域而异,而产出长度则与BERTScore一致并负相关。 因此,表面衡量标准有可能惩罚有根据的阐述,同时奖励更接近参考但不太完整的较短描述。

blocks.en: Second, field type shapes the primary error distribution. Context fields ( Find spot , Place , Assoc name ), are reliably grounded when present and are rarely inferred when absent. Whereas content fields such as Technique and Subjects encourage domain-specific elaboration and visual inference, resulting in higher hallucination rates even when provided. Materials occupies an intermediate position: it is usually grounded when present, but can trigger unsupported object-type or quality inferences. The context arm ( S_ctx ), therefore, improves primary fidelity, while the content arm ( S_cont ) increases primary coverage at higher hallucination cost. These patterns show that many errors are not arbitrary fabrications. Instead, models transfer values across neighbouring fields, narrow broad catalogue labels using domain priors, or convert visual observations into field-specific claims. The error often lies not in whether a claim is plausible, but in whether the correct field supports it.
blocks.zh: 第二,字段类型会塑造主错误分布. 上下文字段(Find spot., Place., Asoc name.),当存在时可靠地扎根,缺席时很少被推断出. 技术领域和主题领域等内容领域鼓励特定领域的阐述和视觉推论,因此即使提供了幻觉率也较高。 材料占据了中间位置:在存在时通常被打锚,但可以触发无支持的对象类型或质量推论. 因此,上下文臂(S_ctx)提高了初级忠诚度,而内容臂(S_cont)以更高的幻觉成本提高了初级覆盖度. 这些模式表明许多错误不是任意捏造的. 取而代之的是模型跨相邻字段传输值,使用域前名的窄宽目录标签,或者将视觉观测转换为特定字段的索赔. 错误往往不在于索赔是否合理,而在于正确的领域是否支持索赔。

blocks.en: This field–claim mismatch is the central failure mode our analysis reveals. A generated statement may be visually plausible, historically reasonable, or supported by another metadata field, while still being unsupported by the target field being evaluated. For example, a model may use a Find spot value as a Place of origin, convert a broad technique label into a specific art-historical sub-type, or add subject details visible in the image but absent from the catalogue subject vocabulary. Such cases are difficult to capture with evaluation methods that only check whether a claim is plausible or whether it appears somewhere in the input. Metadata-conditioned generation requires verifying the relation between claims and the specific fields that support them. Omission and hallucination also carry different consequences: omission reduces completeness, whereas unsupported elaboration presents unverified claims as catalogue-grounded facts.

blocks.en: Images further expose this issue, and their effect depends on metadata density. In sparse conditions, images provide grounding evidence that reduces hallucination; under richer metadata, they can amplify content-field elaboration beyond the catalogue record ( Rohrbach et al., 2018 ) . Our evaluation treats catalogue metadata as the reference schema, not as an exhaustive description of the object. Image-grounded claims may therefore be visually valid while remaining unsupported by the metadata field under evaluation. This distinction is important for cultural heritage generation: a description can be visually plausible while going beyond what the catalogue schema supports.
blocks.zh: 图像进一步暴露出这个问题,其效果取决于元数据密度. 在稀有的条件下,图像提供了能减少幻觉的地基证据;在更丰富的元数据下,它们能够将内容领域阐述扩展至目录记录之外(Rohrbach等,2018年). 我们的评价将目录元数据视为参考计划,而不是对对象的详尽描述。 因此,基于图像的索偿要求可能具有视觉上的有效性,同时仍然得不到所评价的元数据领域的支持。 这种区别对文化遗产的产生很重要:描述可以看似合理,而超出目录计划所支持的范围。

blocks.en:
These findings have implications for evaluating metadata-conditioned generation. Reference similarity metrics, field-level NLI, and claim-level verification capture different aspects of quality and can produce conflicting condition rankings. NLI-based coverage measures
semantic consistency rather than value accuracy: a description can receive an entailment verdict without correctly reproducing the
catalogue value ( Falke et al., 2019 ) , and no single evaluation layer separates omission from hallucination. Evaluation
should therefore be field-aware: not only whether a claim is supported, but which field supports it, whether that field was
provided, and whether the claim stays within its intended scope. Treating all metadata fields as equivalent hides important differences in coverage rate, hallucination risk, and omission. More broadly, metadata-conditioned generation should be treated as a schema-alignment problem: models must learn not only what information is available, but what each field permits them to assert. In cultural heritage settings, unsupported elaboration can present speculative interpretation as authoritative descriptions.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We presented a controlled study of metadata-conditioned description generation for museum objects with multimodal LLMs, varying the number of metadata fields, their type, and image availability over a fixed object set.
Increasing the number of provided fields does not monotonically improve faithfulness: entailment-based coverage of the provided fields rises, and so does the rate of unsupported claims about fields withheld from the prompt. Field type affects both quantities at a fixed number of fields.
Context fields are either expressed or omitted and are rarely misstated, whereas content fields such as Technique and Subjects are expressed whenever provided but yield the highest rate of unsupported claims and encourage visual inference, domain-specific elaboration, and schema-boundary errors. Reference-based similarity and entailment-based coverage do not distinguish these behaviours: they order the matched conditions differently, and a difference in error type is read as a difference in quality.
Faithfulness requires attributing each generated claim to the metadata field it addresses and verifying it against that field’s value, which separates support, contradiction, and omission. For cultural heritage applications, this matters because fluent descriptions can present plausible but unsupported interpretation as authoritative object information. Systems deployed in this setting should therefore expose the provenance of each claim, so that catalogue-supported content can be reviewed separately from content generated from parametric knowledge.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了对具有多模式LLMs的博物馆对象的元数据条件描述生成的可控研究,该研究改变了元数据字段的数量、类型以及固定对象集的图像可用性。
增加所提供栏目的数量不会单调地提高忠诚度:对所提供栏目的涵盖率上升,对被扣栏的栏目提出的无根据索赔率也上升了。 字段类型影响到固定字段的两种数量。

忠诚要求将每个产生的要求归结到它所处理的元数据领域,并根据这个领域的价值加以核实,这个价值将支持、矛盾和遗漏分开。 对于文化遗产的应用来说,这一点很重要,因为流利的描述可以提供合理但无根据的解释作为权威的物体信息。 因此,在此情况下部署的系统应暴露每项索赔的出处,以便可以对目录支持的内容与从参数知识中产生的内容分开审查。

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We distinguish contextual and content fields, but this distinction may not be absolute: some fields can behave differently depending on object type, record format, and catalogue practice. For example, Materials is usually grounded reliably when present, but can still trigger unsupported object-type or quality inferences. Future work should examine whether field categories should be defined dynamically based on both schema role and object-specific usage.
blocks.zh: 我们区分了上下文和内容字段,但这种区分可能不是绝对的:有些字段可以视对象类型,记录格式,以及目录惯例的不同而有不同的行为. 例如,材料在存在时通常会可靠地被定位,但仍能触发无支持的对象类型或质量推论. 今后的工作应审查是否应根据计划作用和特定对象的用途来动态地界定实地类别。

blocks.en: Our claim-level factuality is evaluated with an automatic nugget-verification pipeline and two crowdworkers rather than expert curator annotation. We validate the pipeline through span checks and agreement with NLI-based field signals, but automated verification may still miss subtle curatorial distinctions. Future work should include expert review, especially for visually plausible claims that are not recorded in the catalogue metadata.
blocks.zh: 我们的主张层面的事实通过一个自动的黄金核查管道和两个人群工作者而不是专家主管来评估。 我们通过跨度检查和与基于核糖核酸的实地信号达成协议来验证管道,但自动化核查可能仍然忽略了细微的目录区分。 今后的工作应包括专家审查,特别是对于目录元数据中未记录的明显可信的主张。

blocks.en: Finally, expert references are selective descriptions rather than exhaustive records, which partly explains the divergence between reference similarity and field-level support. Our evaluation treats catalogue metadata as the authoritative source of support, which is appropriate for studying schema-faithful generation, but catalogue records may omit details visible in the image or known from external sources. Future work should examine how humans and domain experts balance descriptiveness, visual plausibility, and catalogue fidelity, and should distinguish catalogue-supported, image-supported, and externally supported claims rather than treating all unsupported content as equivalent.
blocks.zh: 最后,专家参考是选择性说明,而不是详尽无遗的记录,这在一定程度上解释了参考相似性和外地一级支助之间的差异。 我们的评价将目录元数据视为权威的支持来源,这适合于研究有计划的忠实生成,但目录记录可能会省略图像中可见或外界已知的细节. 今后的工作应审查人类和领域专家如何平衡描述性、视觉可信性和目录忠诚性,并应区分目录支持的、图像支持的和外部支持的主张,而不是将所有不支持的内容视为同等内容。

blocks.en: Ethical Considerations
blocks.zh: 道德考虑

blocks.en: LLM-generated cultural heritage descriptions can shape how public audiences understand objects, places, and cultural histories. Our results show that fluent descriptions may introduce plausible but unsupported interpretations, especially for content fields such as Technique and Subjects . In public-facing settings, such errors risk presenting speculative claims as authoritative information.
blocks.zh: LLM生成的文化遗产描述可以塑造公众受众如何理解物体,地点和文化历史. 我们的结果显示,流利的描述可能会引入合理但无根据的解释,特别是在内容领域,例如Technique和Debjects。 在公开场合,这种错误有可能将投机性索赔作为权威信息。

blocks.en: This risk is particularly important for collections whose documentation is uneven across regions, periods, or communities. If models elaborate more confidently for some cultural-geographic contexts than others, generated descriptions may reinforce existing documentation imbalances rather than correct them. We therefore do not recommend using these systems as standalone curatorial tools. Instead, domain experts should review generated descriptions, and systems should show which claims are supported by catalogue metadata, which are inferred from images, and which remain uncertain.
blocks.zh: 这种风险对于不同区域、不同时期或不同社区文件记录不均的收集尤为重要。 如果模型比其他模型更自信地阐述某些文化地理背景,生成的描述可能强化而不是纠正现有的文献不平衡。 因此,我们不建议使用这些系统作为独立的典狱工具。 相反,域专家应审查生成的描述,系统应显示哪些主张得到目录元数据的支持,这些元数据从图像中推断出来,而且仍然不确定。

blocks.en: Our work uses existing museum catalogue records and object images. We do not collect personal data or generate descriptions about living individuals. The main ethical concern is representational: ensuring that automated description generation does not overstate, distort, or homogenise cultural knowledge.
blocks.zh: 我们的工作使用现有的博物馆目录记录和物品图像. 我们不收集个人数据,也不产生关于活人的说明。 主要的伦理问题是代表性:确保自动描述生成不会过度描述、扭曲或同质化文化知识。

This ensures all ten regions are represented in phase 2 and that the ceiling conditions ( R and T ) use the richest metadata available within each region rather than a globally imposed minimum.

blocks.en: C.1 Qualitative Error Patterns
blocks.zh: C.1 定性出错模式

blocks.en: We complement the aggregate claim-level analysis with qualitative inspection of hallucinated and silent field outcomes. The dominant pattern is schema-boundary overreach: models generate claims that are plausible in the artefact domain yet unsupported by the specific catalogue field being evaluated. Table 18 summarises the main error mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 我们补充索赔总额分析,对幻觉和沉默的实地结果进行定性检查。 主要的规律是图案范围过大:模型产生在人工兽域中是可信的,但没有得到正在评价的具体目录域的支持。 表18总结了主要出错机制.

blocks.en: Table 18: Qualitative schema-boundary error patterns identified from hallucinated and silent field-level outcomes. The examples illustrate recurring mechanisms rather than exhaustive error categories.
blocks.zh: 表18:从幻觉和沉默的场级结果中识别出的定性计程-边界误差模式. 这些例子说明了反复出现的机制,而不是详尽无遗的错误类别。

blocks.en: Errors involving Place and Find spot arise from substitution, over-specification, or redundancy. Models sometimes assign a Find spot value to Place ; for example, an object catalogued with Place : Central America is described as Meso-America , a value present only in Find spot . In other cases, models narrow broad place labels using information from Culture or Production date , such as describing a Greek object as ancient Greece . Models also add temporal or contextual qualifiers not supported by the target field: objects catalogued with broad Place values such as Egypt or India receive descriptors such as ancient , and Production date ranges are occasionally extended beyond the recorded value. Conversely, some apparent Find spot silence reflects redundant documentation rather than omission: several Chinese records use values such as Found/Acquired: China , which add no geographic information beyond the broader Place value. These cases illustrate how geographic claims may remain semantically plausible while violating the intended distinction between neighbouring catalogue fields.
blocks.zh: 涉及错误 位置和查找点来自替代、过量的规格或冗余。 模型有时会给 Place 分配一个查找点值;例如,一个与 Place 一起编目的对象:中美洲被描述为中美,这个值仅存在于Find spot . 在其他情况下,模型使用来自Culture或Production日期的信息来缩小宽地标签,例如将希腊物体描述为古希腊. 模型还添加了目标字段不支持的时空或上下文限定语:被广泛编目的对象 埃及或印度等地的值得到古代等描述,生产日期范围偶尔会被扩展至记录值之外. 反之,一些明显的Find spoint silence反映了多余的文献而非遗漏:一些中国记录使用"Found/Afred:China"等值,除了更广泛的Place值之外,没有添加任何地理信息. 这些案件表明,地理主张在违反邻近目录领域之间原定的区别的同时,可能仍然完全合理。

blocks.en: Technique errors reflect over-specification when the field is present and unsupported curatorial elaboration when it is withheld. When Technique is provided, models sometimes replace broad catalogue values with more specialised art-historical subtypes; Greek objects catalogued simply as painted are described using terms such as black-figure technique . When Technique is withheld, models generate aesthetic or interpretive descriptions rather than recoverable manufacturing processes: objects with withheld values such as painted , carved , or gilded receive claims about naturalism, craftsmanship, or calligraphic style. These outputs are domain-plausible but not supported by the metadata field being evaluated, explaining the high bonus wrong rates for Technique : absent process information invites stylistic elaboration rather than recovery of catalogue-vocabulary manufacturing terms.
blocks.zh: 技术出错反映了场面存在时的过量规格,而场面被扣时则没有支持的编程. 当提供Technique时,模型有时会用更专门的艺术历史子类型来取代广义的目录值;简单的被刻画的希腊物品被描述为使用黑图技术等术语. 当Technique被扣留时,模型生成审美或解释性描述,而不是可回收的制造过程:有被扣留价值的物体,如被漆、被雕刻或被镀金,都会收到关于自然主义、手工艺或书法风格的主张。 这些产出具有域名性,但没有得到正在评价的元数据字段的支持,这解释了Technique的高奖金误收率:没有流程信息,就会引起结构化的阐述,而不是恢复目录-vocabulary制造术语.

blocks.en: For Subjects , models frequently elaborate beyond the controlled subject label through visual and compositional inference. Controlled-vocabulary subject labels are often sparse relative to the visual complexity of the depicted object; models expand the label using visual priors and domain knowledge drawn from pretraining, generating content that is image-consistent but not catalogue-consistent. Records labelled only as bird may receive additional claims about foliage, vine motifs, or decorative scenery, while a record labelled horse/ass may be described as including a detailed saddle. The resulting claims are not supported by the catalogue subject value but reflect legitimate visual observations of content not captured by the controlled vocabulary.
blocks.zh: 对于主题,模型经常通过视觉和构象推论在被控制对象标签之外进行精心的阐述. 相较于被描绘对象的视觉复杂性,受控-vocabulary主题标签往往很少;模型利用从预训中提取的视觉前科和域名知识来扩展标签,生成内容符合图像但不符合目录要求. 仅标注为鸟类的记录可收到关于叶片、藤本植物或装饰性景物的额外索赔,而标注为马/驴的记录可被描述为包括了详细的马鞍。 由此产生的主张没有目录主题值的支持,而是反映了对未被控制词汇所捕获的内容的合法视觉观察.

blocks.en: Material mentions are comparatively well grounded, consistent with the low primary hallucination rates for Materials in the quantitative results; errors here are edge cases rather than a dominant failure mode. Most arise not from incorrect material identification but from unsupported inference triggered by the material value: pottery may be realised as bowl , and jadeite as high-quality jadeite . A related pattern is field-boundary confusion: models occasionally assign a value to a neighbouring field, treating glaze or velvet as a material when the catalogue records them under Technique . These cases show how correctly grounded material mentions can induce additional assumptions about object type or quality, and how schema proximity between fields creates an additional source of boundary error.
blocks.zh: 材料提及的基础相对良好,与定量结果中材料的初级幻觉率较低相一致;这里的错误是边缘情况,而不是主要故障模式。 多数原因不是材料鉴定不正确,而是材料价值引发的无根据推论:陶器可能变成碗;而玉器则变成高质量的玉器。 一个相关的模式是字段边界混淆:模型偶尔会给相邻的字段分配一个值,当目录将它们记录在"Technique"下时,将glaze或天鹅绒当作一种材料. 这些案例表明,正确的基础材料可如何引起对物体类型或质量的额外假设,以及不同字段之间的距离如何造成另一个边界出错源。

blocks.en: The dominant failure mode is therefore not arbitrary hallucination, but boundary overreach across neighbouring schema fields, visual priors, and domain-plausible curatorial conventions. This explains why fluent descriptions can appear plausible to a general reader while violating the intended relation between catalogue field, field value, and generated claim.
blocks.zh: 因此,占主导地位的失败模式不是任意的幻觉,而是跨越相邻的 schema 域、视觉前科和域-可验证的地盘惯例的边界被超越。 这解释了为什么在一般读者看来,流利的描述似乎是合理的,同时违反了目录领域、实地价值和索赔之间预期的关系。
